storedfalldamage.configuration.title: Stored Fall Damage Config
storedfalldamage.configuration.activatio:
The requirements to store damage. Can be either...
 ALWAYS - Always try to store damage when taking lethal damage
 NEVER - Disable storing damage (turns off the mod, essentially)
HOLDING_CLUTCH_ITEM - Only tries to store damage when holding the associated "clutch" items for the incoming damage type
storedfalldamage.configuration.Storing S: Settings related to the "Storing Shield" effect
storedfalldamage.configuration.unstable_: The base amount of time (in ticks) of Unstable Hearts. For example, setting this to 300 ensures that the player has 15 seconds (before extra time) to heal any stored damage.

Increases the amount of time (in ticks) Unstable Hearts will last for depending on the amount of stored damage taken. For example, setting this to 20 would make Unstable Hearts last another second for every half-heart of damage stored.
storedfalldamage.configuration.storing_s: The amount of time Storing Shield will be active for in ticks. For example, setting this to 100 would make Storing Shield last for 5 seconds.
storedfalldamage.configuration.Unstable: Settings related to the "Unstable Hearts" effect
storedfalldamage.configuration.use_unsta: Enable "Unstable Hearts", which serves as a timer for healing stored damage. If the effect runs out and the player is still storing damage, instantly kill them.
storedfalldamage.configuration.scaling.t:
A multiplier to any incoming stored damage. For example, when taking 10 damage at half a heart (5 hearts of unscaled stored damage)...
- 0.5x scaling -> 2.5 hearts of stored damage
 - 1x scaling -> 5 hearts of stored damage (default)
2x scaling -> 10 hearts of stored damage
10x scaling -> 50 hearts of stored damage
storedfalldamage.configuration.limit.too: The maximum amount of stored damage, in half hearts. Going over the limit results in the player dying regardless of whether the damage type can normally be stored or not to prevent players from absorbing massive amounts of damage.
storedfalldamage.configuration.storing_s: A multiplier to any incoming damage while Storing Shield is active. If a player takes damage from a shielded damage type scale the damage that would've been taken by this value and add it to the player's stored damage. Set to 0 to prevent additional stored damage.
storedfalldamage.configuration.use_stori: Enables the activation of "Storing Shield" upon storing damage. Storing Shield prevents the player from taking damage from specific sources depending on the damage type that triggered Storing Shield. For example, storing fall damage makes you immune to fire damage for a short time.
